item.title: A new study gives us a clearer picture on how many people have been deported
item.description: Cracking down on immigration has been the centerpiece of the Trump administration, but the government has limited the public's access to the numbers. A new study gives us a clearer picture.

item.title: Merck and Moderna release promising data on cancer vaccine trial
item.description: A study of a personalized vaccine combined with an existing immunotherapy found the treatment helped patients with melanoma avoid cancer recurrence. The combination trains the patient's immune system to go after cancer cells.

item.title: At a Texas high school football game, fans offer a glimpse into evolving politics
item.description: We talk with voters at a Texas high school football game at the tailgate, in line at the concession booth and in the stands to hear about the issues that matter to Texans this cycle.

item.title: Father who killed the Bend school shooter speaks to Oregon Public Broadcasting
